_meta.purpose: Illustrative inputs for the KPIs the engine cannot compute yet. Every KPI built from these is tagged 'Placeholder value' in the explorer. Replace a value with a sourced one and change its provenance; the tag stays until the KPI's method is implemented.

market_value_sek_per_m2.basis: Illustrative Stockholm office market value; replace with a valuation or DCF.

opex_sek_per_m2_yr.basis: Illustrative operating cost for the LCC sum.

npv_uplift_share.basis: Illustrative incremental NPV of the alternative versus continuing as is.

option_value_share.basis: Illustrative value of being able to switch use later.

value_retention_s2_y10.basis: Adaptable alternative, S2 adverse, year 10, from the worked example in the CAVF cheat sheet (A5).

crrem_misalignment_year.basis: Illustrative; use the official CRREM tool with the right pathway.

carbon_payback_years.basis: Illustrative payback of the extra upfront carbon of flexibility.

feasible_uses.basis: Illustrative count of the six use profiles the shell can host without a critical blocker.

replication_index.basis: Illustrative share of the solution transferable to similar buildings.

transformation_months_base.basis: Illustrative fixed duration of a conversion.

transformation_months_per_1000m2.basis: Illustrative duration that scales with floor area.

disruption_weeks.basis: Illustrative period of reduced use during works.

utilization.basis: Illustrative occupied share of available hours.

delivered_services.basis: Illustrative count of services the building delivers.

energy_flexibility_share.basis: Illustrative share of demand that can be moved in time.

recoverable_fraction.basis: Illustrative recoverable fraction q of that mass.

reuse_value_sek_per_kg.basis: Illustrative net value (resale minus recovery cost).

counterfactual_newbuild_kgco2e_per_m2.basis: Illustrative upfront carbon (A1-A5) of demolish and rebuild, the counterfactual for avoided GWP.
